item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second, silent, 16:9 motion-graphics concept ad for ClearDay, a fictional daily-planning app. Design the original demo UI yourself: no existing screenshots or logo required. Calm minimalist blue-and-white aesthetic, very pale blue background, white rounded UI cards, dark navy readable sans-serif type, soft blue accents, generous whitespace. Straight-on flat UI presentation, fixed camera, no people, no photorealistic devices. Simple polished 2D product animation with smooth gentle easing. Timeline: 0–2 seconds: a large white app window shows a messy to-do list, scattered slightly overlapping task cards with short labels 'Email', 'Groceries', 'Project', 'Walk', 'Call'. Small headline above: 'Too much to do?' 2–5.5 seconds: those same cards smoothly align and organize themselves into three clean sections labeled 'Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening', clearly showing a messy list becoming a simple organized daily plan. Blue check circles and subtle time markers emphasize structure; keep layout uncluttered and labels large. Headline becomes 'One simple plan.' 5.5–8 seconds: transition gently to a clean centered end card, with large exact brand wordmark 'ClearDay' in navy, a tiny simple blue sun icon, and smaller line 'Make room for your day.' Hold the end card clearly to the end. Prioritize legible typography and stable coherent UI. No voiceover, music, sound effects or audio of any kind. No unrelated branding, no extra scenes.
